The largest entertainment industry in the world is training the next generation. You’re not paying attention.

Kingdom Code’s primary domain is theology, but we don’t stop there.

This year we’ve exposed Babylonian inversions in philosophy, theology, and politics. But modern Christianity makes a fatal mistake: thinking the Creator is confined to a church building when all of creation and everything in it is His.

If you’ve followed my work on Gnosticism and Western theology, you know it’s deeply infected by “earth bad, wait for heaven” doctrine. That is not the gospel. We are called to steward our territory and expand His kingdom, not be spectators.

So Kingdom Code advances to another domain in 2026: gaming.

This is an industry I grew up with and still have passion for. I left the hobby years ago, but I know it personally, I watched its soul get extracted by greed and corruption. Now I’m applying the Kingdom Code framework to analyze it, because that space is shaping the minds of the next generation.

Gaming is the biggest entertainment industry in the world. It’s far more important than people think.

If you’re interested in that space and you know what I’m talking about, you can subscribe separately.

KCG

Remember when games had soul? We show you exactly what died, how it was killed, and how to recognize what survived.

By Rocka

If not, Kingdom Code continues on the theology front with primary focus on the Ethiopian Bible canon investigation.

Same framework. Different battlefield.
